desc: Daily driver rooted on the internal-SSD exFAT 'linux' partition (p3, 170 GiB, pinned by 5001), per CJ 2026-10-25. Pattern = proven SD-root: exFAT holds an ext4 wallace-root.img loop-mounted as /, with the 3006-fixed /run tmpfs + PID-1 shutdown pivot. AMENDED 2026-10-25 (claude): the root is a CLONE of the proven SD64 wallace-root.img (Xorg/i3, WiFi, helpers: what CJ actually uses), not Astra's staged root, which has no desktop. Steps: (1) 5003 write test PASS (write + reboot verify). (2) Daily+NVMe kernel = daily301 flags (DOCKCHANNEL DOCKCHANNEL_NBCON MACSMC HID_TYPE_FIX T6040_PPP WIFI PCIE CPUFREQ TRACKPAD_FW TRACKPAD_RESET_CONTRACT) + NVME NVME_IOQ_SIZE NVME_EXFAT, two identical builds; DTB dts/t6040-j614s-dcuart-wifi-cpufreq-nvmeroot.dts (= sdroot DT with ans_mbox/ans_sart/ans_nvme okay; PMU SPMI, smc_rtc, smc_reboot stay disabled). (3) READ-ONLY FIRST BOOT of that never-booted kernel+DTB combination: the existing SD-root daily initramfs, so NVMe only enumerates while the SD root comes up; confirm SD, WiFi, BT, trackpad and nvme0n1 topology. (4) One-shot installer (scripts/t6040-init-nvme-root-install, built by scripts/t6040-build-nvme-root-install-initramfs.sh from the pinned Alpine bootstrap): 5003 p3 pins plus exFAT clean, SD64 source gates (GL9755 ancestry, LABEL=SD64, 6 GiB, UUID 4c41b99c, s_state clean), SD and every other NVMe partition/namespace read-only; copies to p3/wallace-root.img.partial hashing in-stream, drop_caches re-hash, truncate to 16 GiB, e2fsck -fn/-fp, tune2fs -U 988d97b4-06ba-40d7-8f70-7899bb6fa297, resize2fs, e2fsck -fn, rename, fsck.exfat -n, whole-disk writes == p3 writes. Checker scripts/t6040-check-nvme-root-install-transcript.py; host deadline 15 min (6 GiB SD read + ~10 GiB exFAT zero-fill at maxcpus=1). Needs the SD64 card inserted. (5) nvmeroot init = scripts/t6040-nvmeroot-init (generated by scripts/t6040-gen-nvmeroot-init.py from the sdroot init; only storage gates differ), tested in the 3006 harness. (6) Attended boot, 3 cold boots with clean poweroff + fsck postcheck. maxcpus=1 until 205 is solved; USB PD added once 305 passes.
author: claude

hashes.bootargs: maxcpus=1 idle=nop nokaslr pd_ignore_unused clk_ignore_unused console=tty0 fbcon=font:TER16x32 ignore_loglevel printk.devkmsg=on console=ttydc0 console=tty0 rdinit=/init
